title: Atomic DIO admission can deadlock against a generation-lease callback
description: DodagState.process_authenticated_dio[_evidence] holds the DODAG RLock while LinkLayer.transact_authenticated_schc_dio waits for foreign generation leases. An allowed elevate_authenticated_dio callback runs outside the Link lock while holding such a lease and may call process_dio/wait on the DODAG lock, producing DODAG-lock -> lease versus lease -> DODAG-lock deadlock. Establish Link-wait -> DODAG-lock ordering (while retaining atomic SCHC-policy+routing commit), and add a deterministic two-thread regression.
close_reason: Implemented: process_authenticated_dio (python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py:483-511) holds the DODAG lock only for the state snapshot (:496-498) and calls link_layer.accept_authenticated_dio outside it; LinkLayer.transact_authenticated_schc_dio waits for foreign generation leases inside the security lock (_wait_for_foreign_generation_leases_unlocked, link_layer.py:693,:704-707) and runs elevate callbacks outside the lock with lease released after (:699-702) — the DODAG-lock -> generation-lease cycle is eliminated. python/tests/timing + python/tests/link: 1704 passed, 12 skipped.
